prompt: Complete SharedReferenceRoundTrip.roundTrip so a list of Book objects survives a serialization round trip with its shared Author reference still shared.
explanation: ObjectOutputStream keeps a handle table of everything it has already written, so the second time it meets the same Author it writes a back-reference instead of a second copy. ObjectInputStream replays that table, which is why both restored books point at one Author object and == is true. Writing the whole list through a single stream pair is what makes this work -- serializing each book separately would produce two independent Authors.
hints: Write the whole list with one out.writeObject(books) call rather than looping over the books.
Serialize into a ByteArrayOutputStream, then read from a ByteArrayInputStream built from its toByteArray().
Reading gives you an Object; cast it to List<Book>, which is why the method carries a SuppressWarnings annotation for that unchecked cast.
